The children stack IS the content: hslot | lk | blk | sq | bvc | vc abut in landed-chain order on the 43.2-um child lattice (gaps 43.2 / 21.6 / 21.6 / 21.6 / 21.6 um, every consumer next to its producer), so the outline is that stack plus the minimum rule channels: W 43.2 (the f_host / f_lf / t_host pin channel, 1,000+ pins), E 475.2 -> 457.92 (25.92-um reset-station channel, >= 20 um pin-edge rule), N top 45.36 -> 28.08.  Child packing 60% -> 63%; the remaining white space is the narrower sq / vc / hslot (227-259 um) under the 388.8-um lk / bands column.  The reviewed render (r3d, 518 x 1426, 3 leaves, 36% packing) is obsolete.  Same ports, same latency on every port.  rev3: mu_lp rev3 (STW-S81c-COLLA4-SEQ 10-22, STEWARD-S81c order 21:00, from rev2 075604603 gate classes): (1) pin ranges = the child pin spans (t_host -1,522.9 / s_j -381.8 / vo_n -154.3 were pin-order detours, not logic); (2) u_l0 reset run rebuilt in the parent from rr[0] (same 4 edges, OT_MU_LP_R3 + derived core lb3) as 4 stationed stages instead of the band pin -> u_l0 ~680 um hop (-702.9); hslot run u_rh stationed along the E channel to the hslot S face (-175.1); (3) clock: spine with BUFx2 pads (FB), pd 0.4.  Same ports, same latency on every port, same outline 475.2 x 1512, same CLOSED children.

reset_landing.reason: Actual generated source has four-stage independent regional reset ports and kept bounded final copies. No additional reset alias or physical hidden stage.

clock_why: rev3 FB: rev2 spine topology (child-insertion leaf targets) with BUFx2 pad chains instead of HB4 delay cells, so the pads scale with the BUFx24 trunk across corners (rev2: TT linked-child boundary flops 1006-1028 ps but FF u_blk 789-826 vs u_l1 819-871 = 82 ps pair; u_l0-u_hs 79).  rev2 (gate 15:57, ep5 cts.log): "cts" + child_centre_tap left the six hard children unbalanced -- child_centre_tap is armed only for landed multiple_cts_roots kits, so the tap never ran; child clock pins arrived 838..1674 ps (u_l0 internal insertion 551 ps vs 233-300 for the others), FF hold -589 ps on 2,434 IO endpoints (u_l2/vi_n), 23k hold buffers, DPL-0033 overlaps.  The cluster default "spine" puts each hard child clock pin on its own leaf with the child insertion (Liberty max_clock_tree_path) as target, so every child boundary lands at one arrival.
pin_ranges_why: rev3 (STW-S81c-COLLA4-SEQ 10-22): rev2 gave every W/E/N group the whole 216-669.6 window (or the whole face), so the pin placer interleaved them and t_host (u_l0 W face y 610.6-668.2) landed down to y 219 -> t_host[7] reg->out -1,522.9 ps through ~1.8 ns of buffered detour in the 43-um W channel; s_j -381.8, vo_n -154.3.  Each group now spans exactly its child pins (u_l0 W: f_host 217-607, f_lf 608-610, t_host 611-668; u_l0 E: s_hc_w 273-281, s_hw_w 282-576, s_j 577-610, s_jd_w 611, st_rg_w 613; u_l2 N: cw_v/cw_a 91-94, cw_d 94-160, vi_n 160-232, vo_n 233-304, tap_k/sink_k 305-309), so every child-pin -> port run is a straight ~45 um hop on its own track; f_ks / t_kd / f_mc / t_mf / S face unchanged (rev2).
